surface_function: A safe, welcoming entry city. Warm streets, friendly faces, surface kindness.
hidden_function: A filter for resonance, curiosity, empathy, and symbolic awareness. Shallow players see only the surface; deep players find hidden paths.

hidden_paths.name: The Listening Wall
hidden_paths.description: A wall in the old quarter that hums during quasar_active state. Touch it, and you hear your own memories distorted through the Veil.

hidden_paths.name: Mira's Garden
hidden_paths.description: A hidden garden behind the warmth of Caetherra's surface. Only visible after Mira has revealed her true name.

hidden_paths.name: The Echo Corridor
hidden_paths.description: A passage that only appears during storm state. It leads to dream fragments left by previous visitors.
